claims: The Mediterranean is an intercontinental sea connecting Europe, Africa, and Asia.
The Mediterranean serves as a major maritime link between the Atlantic Ocean and the Black Sea.
The Mediterranean is enclosed by Europe to the north, Africa to the south, and Asia to the east.
The Mediterranean occupies about 970,000 sq mi (2,510,000 sq km).
The Mediterranean has a maximum depth of approximately 16,000 ft (4,900 m).
The Mediterranean is connected to the Atlantic Ocean via the Strait of Gibraltar.
The Mediterranean is connected to the Black Sea via the Dardanelles/Bosporus.
The Mediterranean is connected to the Red Sea via the Suez Canal.
The Mediterranean is divided by a submarine ridge between Sicily and Africa into western and eastern basins.
The western and eastern basins of the Mediterranean encompass the Adriatic, Aegean, Tyrrhenian, Ionian, and Ligurian seas.
The Mediterranean region is known for hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters.
The Mediterranean region is warming 20% faster than the global average.
Increased water demand in the Mediterranean region is expected to double or triple by 2050.
Water temperatures in the Mediterranean region are projected to rise by 1.8°C to 3.5°C by 2100.
